create-pdf-custom-title-page.title: Create PDF with Custom Title Page
create-pdf-custom-title-page.description: Shows how to generate a new PDF, add a title page, and apply custom font, size, color, and alignment using Aspose.Pdf.

insert-image-into-pdf-absolute-coordinat.title: Insert High-Resolution Image into PDF with Absolute Positioning
insert-image-into-pdf-absolute-coordinat.description: Demonstrates how to add a high‑resolution image to a PDF page using Aspose.Pdf's ImageStamp and position it with absolute X/Y coordinates.

create-searchable-pdf-from-scanned-image.title: Generate Searchable PDF with Invisible OCR Text
create-searchable-pdf-from-scanned-image.description: The example loads a scanned PDF, iterates through its pages, and overlays invisible OCR text using Aspose.Pdf so the document becomes searchable. The invisible text is added as a zero‑size, fully transparent TextFragment and the result is saved as a new PDF.

add-indented-paragraph-with-line-spacing.title: Add Paragraph Indent and Line Spacing to PDF
add-indented-paragraph-with-line-spacing.description: The example loads an existing PDF, creates a TextFragment, sets line spacing and simulates a first‑line indent by adjusting the position, then adds the formatted paragraph to the first page and saves the result.

add-multi-level-toc-to-pdf.title: Add Multi-Level Table of Contents to PDF
add-multi-level-toc-to-pdf.description: Shows how to insert a Table of Contents page into an existing PDF by detecting heading styles based on font size and adding corresponding page numbers using Aspose.Pdf.

remove-page-from-pdf.title: Remove a PDF Page and Renumber Remaining Pages
remove-page-from-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to delete a specific page from a PDF using Aspose.Pdf and automatically renumber the remaining pages, then save the result.

insert-blank-cover-page-into-pdf.title: Insert Blank Cover Page into PDF
insert-blank-cover-page-into-pdf.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, insert a new blank page at the beginning as a cover sheet, and save the modified document.

replace-word-in-pdf.title: Replace Text in PDF While Preserving Formatting
replace-word-in-pdf.description: Loads a PDF, searches for a specific word using a TextFragmentAbsorber, replaces each occurrence with a new word, and saves the document while keeping the original font, size, and color.

extract-images-from-pdf-to-png.title: Extract Images from PDF and Save as PNG
extract-images-from-pdf-to-png.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, iterate through each page and its image resources, and save every image as a PNG file while preserving the original resolution.

add-digital-signature-to-pdf.title: Add Digital Signature to PDF Using a Self‑Signed Certificate
add-digital-signature-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to insert a visible signature field into a PDF, load a self‑signed PFX certificate, configure a PKCS#7 signature with custom appearance, and sign the document using Aspose.Pdf.

validate-pdf-a1a-compliance-report.title: Validate PDF for PDF/A‑1A Compliance and Generate Report
validate-pdf-a1a-compliance-report.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, validate it against PDF/A‑1A conformance, and generate both a detailed validation log and a concise report.

validate-pdf-a1b-compliance.title: Validate PDF for PDF/A‑1B Compliance and Log Results
validate-pdf-a1b-compliance.description: Shows how to use Aspose.Pdf to verify a PDF file against PDF/A‑1B standards, write a detailed validation log, and display a summary of compliance.

remove-metadata-javascript-embedded-file.title: Clear PDF Metadata, JavaScript, and Embedded Files
remove-metadata-javascript-embedded-file.description: Demonstrates how to remove standard document metadata, XMP packets, JavaScript actions, and embedded file attachments from a PDF using Aspose.Pdf to reduce file size.

set-pdf-expiration-date.title: Set PDF Expiration Date with JavaScript
set-pdf-expiration-date.description: Shows how to embed a JavaScript action in a PDF using Aspose.Pdf so the document closes automatically after a specified expiration date.

flatten-pdf-form-fields.title: Flatten PDF Form Fields to Static Content
flatten-pdf-form-fields.description: Demonstrates how to convert all interactive form fields in a PDF into static content using Aspose.Pdf, then save the flattened document.

check-pdf-incremental-updates.title: Detect PDF Modification Using Creation and Modification Dates
check-pdf-incremental-updates.description: Loads a PDF with Aspose.Pdf and compares its CreationDate and ModDate metadata to determine if the file has been modified after it was created.

add-watermark-layer-merge-layers.title: Add Text Watermark to PDF Pages
add-watermark-layer-merge-layers.description: Loads an existing PDF, creates a semi‑transparent diagonal TextStamp watermark, applies it to every page, and saves the watermarked document.

add-accessibility-tags-to-pdf.title: Add Accessibility Tags to PDF (Headings, Paragraphs, Table)
add-accessibility-tags-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to create a tagged PDF with language, title, heading, paragraph, and table elements using Aspose.Pdf's tagging API for screen‑reader compatibility.

attach-portfolio-pdf-set-description-met.title: Attach PDF Portfolio and Set Custom Description Metadata
attach-portfolio-pdf-set-description-met.description: Demonstrates how to embed another PDF as a portfolio attachment in a target PDF and add a custom description metadata property using Aspose.Pdf.

update-pdf-author-title-metadata.title: Update PDF Metadata (Author and Title) with Aspose.Pdf
update-pdf-author-title-metadata.description: Demonstrates how to read existing PDF metadata, change the Author and Title fields, and save the updated document using Aspose.Pdf.

apply-password-protection-to-pdf.title: Encrypt PDF with User and Owner Passwords and Set Permissions
apply-password-protection-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, apply AES‑256 encryption with user and owner passwords, set specific permissions, and save the protected document.

print-pdf-using-default-handler.title: Print PDF Directly from .NET Using Aspose.Pdf
print-pdf-using-default-handler.description: Shows how to send a PDF to a printer from a .NET application by converting each page to an image with Aspose.Pdf and printing it via the standard PrintDocument workflow.

interrupt-resume-large-pdf-save.title: Batch Process Large PDF with Incremental Save
interrupt-resume-large-pdf-save.description: Demonstrates loading a large PDF, processing pages in batches, and using incremental saving to free resources between batches.

generate-crash-report-pdf.title: Generate Crash Report PDF with Exception Details
generate-crash-report-pdf.description: Creates a PDF file that contains the exception message and stack trace using Aspose.Pdf, demonstrating basic PDF generation and text formatting.

embed-zugferd-xml-into-pdf.title: Embed ZUGFeRD XML into PDF and Verify Embedding
embed-zugferd-xml-into-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to embed a ZUGFeRD invoice XML file into an existing PDF using Aspose.Pdf, optionally mark the PDF as PDF/A‑3, and then verify the embedded file by extracting it.

add-javascript-open-action-to-pdf.title: Add JavaScript Open Action to PDF
add-javascript-open-action-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to embed JavaScript in a PDF using Aspose.Pdf so that an alert dialog appears when the document is opened.

combine-multiple-html-to-pdf.title: Combine Multiple HTML Strings into a Single PDF
combine-multiple-html-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates converting a collection of HTML strings to PDF pages with Aspose.Pdf, applying page size settings, and merging them into one PDF document.

add-styled-table-alternating-row-colors.title: Add Styled Table with Alternating Row Colors to PDF
add-styled-table-alternating-row-colors.description: Shows how to load an existing PDF using Aspose.Pdf, create a table with borders and a header, apply alternating background colors to rows, position the table on a page, and save the updated document.

add-hyperlink-annotation-to-pdf.title: Add Hyperlink Annotation to PDF
add-hyperlink-annotation-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to insert a clickable hyperlink annotation that opens an external website in a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

replace-image-in-pdf-page.title: Replace Image in PDF While Preserving Layout
replace-image-in-pdf-page.description: Loads a PDF, finds Image elements on the first page, and swaps their image data with a new image while keeping the original position and size.

add-page-numbers-to-pdf-footer.title: Add Page Numbers to PDF Footer
add-page-numbers-to-pdf-footer.description: Shows how to insert dynamic page numbers into the footer of each page in a PDF using Aspose.Pdf's TextStamp.

create-pdf-multiple-sections-different-p.title: Create PDF with Multiple Sections and Different Page Sizes
create-pdf-multiple-sections-different-p.description: Demonstrates how to generate a PDF document where each page has a distinct size and orientation (portrait, landscape, custom) using Aspose.Pdf.

merge-pdfs-with-bookmarks.title: Merge PDFs and Preserve Bookmarks
merge-pdfs-with-bookmarks.description: Shows how to combine two PDF files into a single document while copying the outline (bookmark) hierarchy from both source PDFs using Aspose.Pdf.

extract-text-from-pdf-pages.title: Extract Text from PDF Page Range
extract-text-from-pdf-pages.description: Demonstrates how to extract plain text from a specific range of pages in a PDF using Aspose.Pdf and save it to a UTF-8 text file.

add-company-logo-header-to-pdf-pages.title: Add Company Logo Header to PDF Pages
add-company-logo-header-to-pdf-pages.description: Shows how to load an existing PDF with Aspose.Pdf, create an ImageStamp for a logo, place it as a header on each page, and save the modified document.

set-pdf-document-metadata.title: Set PDF Metadata (Creation Date, Modification Date, Keywords)
set-pdf-document-metadata.description: Demonstrates how to assign creation and modification dates and custom keywords to a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, then save the document.

create-pdf-with-embedded-truetype-font.title: Create PDF with Embedded TrueType Font
create-pdf-with-embedded-truetype-font.description: Demonstrates how to register a TrueType font, set it to be embedded, and generate a PDF using Aspose.Pdf so the text renders consistently on any device.

apply-semi-transparent-image-watermark.title: Apply Semi-Transparent Text Watermark to PDF
apply-semi-transparent-image-watermark.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, creating a semi‑transparent TextStamp, and applying it as a diagonal watermark to every page before saving the document.

create-clickable-table-of-contents.title: Create Clickable Table of Contents in PDF
create-clickable-table-of-contents.description: Shows how to generate a PDF with a table of contents where each entry is a clickable link that jumps to its corresponding section page using Aspose.Pdf.

remove-all-annotations-from-pdf.title: Remove All Annotations from PDF
remove-all-annotations-from-pdf.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, clear every annotation on each page, and save the sanitized document.

add-signature-field-to-pdf.title: Add User Signature Field to PDF
add-signature-field-to-pdf.description: Shows how to insert a signature form field into a PDF document and set its visual appearance to match the document style using Aspose.Pdf.

encrypt-pdf-aes256-restrict-permissions.title: Encrypt PDF with AES‑256 and Disable Printing/Copying
encrypt-pdf-aes256-restrict-permissions.description: Shows how to load a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, apply AES‑256 encryption with no permissions (disabling printing and copying), and save the encrypted file.

create-pdf-portfolio.title: Create PDF Portfolio with Embedded PDFs
create-pdf-portfolio.description: Shows how to generate a PDF portfolio by embedding several existing PDF files into a single container using Aspose.Pdf.

add-custom-document-info-and-xmp-metadat.title: Add Custom XML Metadata to PDF Document
add-custom-document-info-and-xmp-metadat.description: Shows how to update a PDF's document information and store custom XML metadata using Aspose.Pdf's DocumentInfo dictionary, then save the modified file.

add-line-annotation-with-custom-color-th.title: Add Colored Line Annotation to PDF
add-line-annotation-with-custom-color-th.description: Shows how to load a PDF, create a line shape with a custom color and thickness, add it to a page, and save the modified document using Aspose.Pdf.

replace-pdf-page-with-html.title: Replace PDF Page with HTML-Generated Page
replace-pdf-page-with-html.description: Shows how to replace a specific page in an existing PDF with a page created from HTML using Aspose.Pdf's HTML‑to‑PDF conversion.

add-javascript-sum-calculation-to-pdf-fo.title: Add JavaScript Sum Calculation to PDF Form
add-javascript-sum-calculation-to-pdf-fo.description: Demonstrates creating a PDF with two input fields and a read‑only result field, then attaching a JavaScript action that calculates and displays the sum when either input field loses focus.

generate-dynamic-pdf-table.title: Create PDF with Dynamic Table Using Aspose.Pdf
generate-dynamic-pdf-table.description: Demonstrates generating a PDF that contains a table whose rows are added dynamically from a collection, including header styling and cell formatting.

create-zugferd-compliant-pdf-invoice.title: Generate ZUGFeRD‑compliant PDF Invoice with Embedded XML
create-zugferd-compliant-pdf-invoice.description: Creates a PDF invoice, adds basic invoice text, and embeds a ZUGFeRD XML file as an attached document, demonstrating how to produce a PDF/A‑3u‑compatible invoice using Aspose.Pdf.

create-pdf-clickable-index.title: Create PDF with Clickable Index
create-pdf-clickable-index.description: Shows how to generate a PDF that contains an index page with clickable links that navigate to separate section pages using Aspose.Pdf.

add-background-template-to-pdf-pages.title: Add Background Image to All PDF Pages
add-background-template-to-pdf-pages.description: Shows how to apply a reusable background image to every page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf's ImageStamp and page iteration.

add-signature-image-stamp-to-last-page.title: Add Signature Image to Last Page of PDF
add-signature-image-stamp-to-last-page.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, create an ImageStamp from a signature PNG, position it on the document's last page, and save the signed PDF.

extract-embedded-files-from-pdf-portfoli.title: Extract Embedded Files from PDF Portfolio
extract-embedded-files-from-pdf-portfoli.description: The code opens a PDF portfolio, enumerates its embedded files, and saves each file to a specified output directory.

create-readonly-text-field-with-default-.title: Create Read‑Only Text Field in PDF
create-readonly-text-field-with-default-.description: Demonstrates how to add a text box form field with a default value and set it to read‑only using Aspose.Pdf.

create-pdf-with-clickable-email-link.title: Create PDF with Clickable Email Link
create-pdf-with-clickable-email-link.description: Shows how to generate a PDF containing a text label and a clickable mailto: link using Aspose.Pdf annotations.

add-captions-below-images-in-pdf.title: Add Captions Below Images in PDF
add-captions-below-images-in-pdf.description: Shows how to iterate over image resources in a PDF and insert a styled caption text fragment beneath each image using Aspose.Pdf.

create-pdf-toc-with-dot-leaders.title: Generate PDF with Table of Contents and Custom Dot Leaders
create-pdf-toc-with-dot-leaders.description: Demonstrates how to create a PDF, add content sections, collect their titles and page numbers, and build a table of contents with custom dot‑leader lines using Aspose.Pdf.

add-popup-note-annotation.title: Add Pop‑up Note Annotation to PDF
add-popup-note-annotation.description: Shows how to create a TextAnnotation (pop‑up note) on a PDF page with Aspose.Pdf and save the updated document.

create-pdf-header-with-current-date.title: Create PDF Header with Current Date using JavaScript
create-pdf-header-with-current-date.description: Shows how to add a read‑only text box field as a header and populate it with the current date via a JavaScript open action in an Aspose.Pdf document.

digitally-sign-pdf-with-timestamp.title: Add Digital Signature with Timestamp to PDF
digitally-sign-pdf-with-timestamp.description: Shows how to sign a PDF using a PKCS#7 certificate and embed a trusted timestamp from a Time‑Stamp Authority with Aspose.Pdf.

create-5x7-inch-postcard-pdf.title: Create a 5x7 Inch Postcard PDF
create-5x7-inch-postcard-pdf.description: Shows how to generate a PDF with a custom 5×7‑inch page size for postcard printing using Aspose.Pdf.

add-background-color-to-pdf-page.title: Add Semi-Transparent Background Color to PDF Page
add-background-color-to-pdf-page.description: Demonstrates how to add a semi‑transparent colored rectangle as a background to the first page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

insert-pdf-page-into-another.title: Insert PDF Page into Another PDF
insert-pdf-page-into-another.description: Demonstrates how to load two PDF documents with Aspose.Pdf, extract a page from the source file, and insert it into a target file at a specified position.

create-pdf-with-dropdown-list.title: Create PDF with Dropdown (ComboBox) Form Field
create-pdf-with-dropdown-list.description: Shows how to generate a PDF containing a ComboBox form field and populate its options from a string array using Aspose.Pdf.

add-page-count-footer-to-pdf.title: Add Page Number Footer to PDF
add-page-count-footer-to-pdf.description: Shows how to insert a custom footer that displays "Page X of Y" on every page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

remove-javascript-from-pdf.title: Remove JavaScript Actions from PDF
remove-javascript-from-pdf.description: Loads a PDF, clears all document‑level, page‑level and annotation JavaScript actions, and saves a cleaned version using Aspose.Pdf.

create-pdf-with-merged-header-table.title: Create PDF Table with Merged Header Cells
create-pdf-with-merged-header-table.description: Shows how to generate a PDF containing a table whose header visually spans multiple columns by adding a placeholder cell and removing its borders.

add-link-annotation-open-pdf-attachment.title: Create Link Annotation that Opens an Embedded PDF
add-link-annotation-open-pdf-attachment.description: Loads a PDF, embeds another PDF as an attachment, and adds a link annotation that launches the attached file when clicked.

create-rotated-landscape-pdf-page.title: Create Landscape PDF Page with Aspose.Pdf
create-rotated-landscape-pdf-page.description: Shows how to generate a PDF document with a landscape‑oriented page by setting the page width and height using Aspose.Pdf.

add-checked-checkbox-form-field.title: Add Checked Checkbox Form Field to PDF
add-checked-checkbox-form-field.description: Shows how to create a PDF document, add a checkbox form field, set its default state to checked, and save the file using Aspose.Pdf.

extract-pdf-outline-hierarchy.title: Extract and Print PDF Outline Hierarchy
extract-pdf-outline-hierarchy.description: Loads a PDF file, checks for the presence of outlines (bookmarks), and recursively prints the outline hierarchy as an indented tree.

create-pdf-table-with-rich-text.title: Create PDF Table with Rich Text Formatting
create-pdf-table-with-rich-text.description: Shows how to generate a PDF containing a table where each cell uses rich‑text formatting such as bold, italic, and colored text using Aspose.Pdf.

add-diagonal-text-stamp-to-pdf.title: Add Line‑like Text Stamp to PDF Pages
add-diagonal-text-stamp-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to add a centered, semi‑transparent text stamp that acts like a line annotation to every page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

insert-automatic-page-numbers-into-pdf.title: Add Automatic Page Numbers to PDF
insert-automatic-page-numbers-into-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to insert a page number stamp that updates automatically across all pages of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

create-pdf-with-background-template.title: Create PDF with Background Template Page
create-pdf-with-background-template.description: Shows how to load a PDF page as a background template, clone it to generate multiple pages, and add page‑specific content such as page numbers.

extract-text-from-pdf-to-utf8-file.title: Extract Text from PDF to UTF-8 File
extract-text-from-pdf-to-utf8-file.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, extract all textual content using TextAbsorber, and write the result to a UTF‑8 encoded text file.

add-javascript-sum-numeric-pdf-form-fiel.title: Add JavaScript to Sum PDF Form Fields
add-javascript-sum-numeric-pdf-form-fiel.description: Demonstrates embedding JavaScript in a PDF with Aspose.Pdf to sum numeric form fields and display the total in a read‑only textbox.

extract-xmp-metadata-from-pdf.title: Extract XMP Metadata from PDF
extract-xmp-metadata-from-pdf.description: Shows how to read the embedded XMP metadata packet from a PDF using Aspose.Pdf and write it to an XML file.

create-multi-page-table-pdf.title: Create Multi‑Page Table in PDF
create-multi-page-table-pdf.description: Shows how to generate a PDF with a table that automatically splits across multiple pages using Aspose.Pdf.

add-line-separator-annotation-to-pdf-pag.title: Add Horizontal Line Separator to PDF Pages
add-line-separator-annotation-to-pdf-pag.description: Shows how to open a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, loop through each page, and draw a horizontal line as a visual separator using Graph and Line objects.

set-pdf-page-rotation-90-degrees.title: Rotate PDF Pages 90 Degrees for Portrait Display
set-pdf-page-rotation-90-degrees.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, setting each page's rotation to 90° so it appears portrait on landscape devices, and saving the modified file.

create-pdf-with-date-picker.title: Create PDF Form with Date Picker Field
create-pdf-with-date-picker.description: Shows how to generate a PDF containing a form field that functions as a date picker by using a TextBoxField, configuring its appearance, and saving the document with Aspose.Pdf.

extract-hyperlinks-from-pdf.title: Extract Hyperlinks from PDF to Text File
extract-hyperlinks-from-pdf.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, iterate through its pages and link annotations, and write each extracted URL to a plain text file.

load-pdf-into-document.title: Load PDF File into Aspose.Pdf Document
load-pdf-into-document.description: Demonstrates how to verify a PDF file's existence, load it into an Aspose.Pdf Document object, and access basic document information such as the page count.

sanitize-pdf-remove-embedded-scripts.title: Sanitize PDF by Removing Embedded JavaScript
sanitize-pdf-remove-embedded-scripts.description: Loads a PDF, deletes any embedded JavaScript actions and clears annotations, then saves the sanitized document. Demonstrates how to mimic HiddenDataSanitizerOptions for script removal using Aspose.Pdf.

sanitize-pdf-remove-metadata-private-inf.title: Remove Search Index and Private Info from PDF
sanitize-pdf-remove-metadata-private-inf.description: Demonstrates how to enable the RemoveSearchIndexAndPrivateInfo flag in Aspose.Pdf's hidden-data sanitization to clear search index and private metadata from a PDF before saving.

convert-pdf-pages-to-rasterized-images-h.title: Convert PDF to HTML with Rasterized Pages (Image DPI 150)
convert-pdf-pages-to-rasterized-images-h.description: Shows how to convert a PDF to HTML while rasterizing each page to external PNG images and setting the image DPI to 150 using Aspose.Pdf.

compress-pdf-images-and-export-jpeg-qual.title: Convert PDF Pages to JPEG Images with Quality 80
compress-pdf-images-and-export-jpeg-qual.description: Shows how to load a PDF, iterate through its pages, and save each page as a JPEG image using Aspose.Pdf with JPEG compression quality set to 80.

convert-pdf-pages-to-jpeg-no-compression.title: Convert PDF Pages to PNG without Compression
convert-pdf-pages-to-jpeg-no-compression.description: Shows how to render each page of a PDF to a PNG image using Aspose.Pdf while preserving the original image data by not applying any compression.

convert-pdf-pages-to-png-images.title: Convert PDF Pages to JPEG Images
convert-pdf-pages-to-png-images.description: Creates a PDF with a known number of pages, uses Aspose.Pdf's JpegDevice to render each page to a JPEG file, and verifies that an image is generated for every page.

selective-page-rasterization-hidden-data.title: Sanitize PDF by Removing All Annotations
selective-page-rasterization-hidden-data.description: Loads a PDF document, clears every page's annotations to eliminate hidden data, and saves the sanitized result.

remove-annotations-and-attachments.title: Remove Annotations and Attachments from PDF
remove-annotations-and-attachments.description: Shows how to strip all page annotations (comments) and embedded file attachments from a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

sanitize-pdfs-remove-metadata.title: Sanitize PDFs by Removing Metadata, JavaScript, Attachments, and Annotations
sanitize-pdfs-remove-metadata.description: Loads PDFs from a source folder, clears document metadata, strips embedded JavaScript, removes attached files and page annotations, then saves a cleaned copy to a target folder.

generate-pdf-crash-report.title: PDF Processing with Custom Crash Report
generate-pdf-crash-report.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, adding a text fragment, saving the document, and generating a detailed custom crash report when an exception occurs.

customize-crash-report-filename-message.title: Customize Crash Report File Name with CrashReportOptions
customize-crash-report-filename-message.description: Shows how to set a custom message for Aspose.Pdf crash reports by using CrashReportOptions.CustomMessage while loading and saving a PDF document.

generate-crash-report-with-custom-output.title: Specify Crash Report Directory and Generate Report
generate-crash-report-with-custom-output.description: The example shows how to set a custom output folder for Aspose.Pdf crash reports using CrashReportOptions, trigger an exception, generate the report, and verify its creation.

pdf-processing-with-crash-report.title: Add Blank Page to PDF with Detailed Error Logging
pdf-processing-with-crash-report.description: Loads a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, adds a blank page, saves the modified file, and wraps the process in a try‑catch block that generates a detailed crash report and writes it to a log file.

add-level-1-heading-to-pdf.title: Create PDF with Level 1 Heading using Tagged Content
add-level-1-heading-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to create a new PDF document, add a level 1 heading via the tagged content API, and save the file. Shows setting language and title for accessibility.

add-hierarchical-numbered-headings.title: Add Decimal Numbering to PDF Headings
add-hierarchical-numbered-headings.description: Demonstrates enabling PDF tagging, creating hierarchical Heading elements with automatic decimal (Arabic) numbering using NumberingStyle.NumeralsArabic, and adding visible heading text to the document.

structured-toc-with-headings.title: Create Structured Table of Contents with Numbered Headings
structured-toc-with-headings.description: Shows how to add multiple Heading objects with different NumberingStyle values, generate a simple TOC page, and add outline bookmarks to a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

add-new-bookmark-to-pdf-outline.title: Add New Bookmark to PDF Outline
add-new-bookmark-to-pdf-outline.description: Demonstrates how to insert a heading as a bookmark into an existing PDF's outline and link it to a specific page using Aspose.Pdf.

add-dynamic-heading-to-pdf.title: Add Dynamic Heading to PDF Using Tagged Content
add-dynamic-heading-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to create a dynamic heading (e.g., user name and date) in a PDF by using Aspose.Pdf's tagged content API, creating a HeaderElement and appending it to the structure tree before saving.

create-pdf-numbered-headings-sanitize.title: Create and Sanitize PDF Headings with Tagging
create-pdf-numbered-headings-sanitize.description: Demonstrates how to generate a PDF with tagged heading elements using Aspose.Pdf and then produce a sanitized version that keeps only the headings and their numbering.

remove-hidden-data-rebuild-headings-pdf.title: Remove Hidden Data and Re‑Tag PDF with Headings
remove-hidden-data-rebuild-headings-pdf.description: The example loads a PDF, strips hidden information such as metadata, annotations, attachments, JavaScript and form fields, then enables auto‑tagging to recreate the heading structure and saves the cleaned, tagged document.

batch-sanitize-pdfs.title: Batch PDF Sanitization – Remove Metadata and Annotations
batch-sanitize-pdfs.description: Demonstrates how to process a folder of PDF files, clear their metadata and remove all annotations, then save the cleaned PDFs to a separate directory.

sanitize-pdf-remove-hidden-data.title: Sanitize Hidden Data from PDF
sanitize-pdf-remove-hidden-data.description: Shows how to load a PDF, remove hidden data such as annotations, metadata, JavaScript, and embedded files using Aspose.Pdf's HiddenDataSanitizer, and save the sanitized file.

check-hidden-annotations-in-pdf.title: Check for Hidden Annotations After PDF Sanitization
check-hidden-annotations-in-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to sanitize a PDF with Aspose.Pdf and then verify whether any hidden annotations remain. It uses the HiddenDataSanitizer and inspects each page's annotations for the Hidden flag.

sanitize-pdf-remove-hidden-data-keep-met.title: Sanitize PDF Hidden Data While Preserving Metadata
sanitize-pdf-remove-hidden-data-keep-met.description: Demonstrates how to configure Aspose.Pdf's HiddenDataSanitizer to keep document metadata while removing all other hidden content from a PDF file.

convert-pdf-pages-to-high-resolution-tif.title: Convert PDF Pages to High-Resolution TIFF Images
convert-pdf-pages-to-high-resolution-tif.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, iterate through each page, and save every page as an individual TIFF file at a specified DPI.

roman-numeral-headings-pdf.title: Create PDF with Roman Numeral Headings and Validate Sequence
roman-numeral-headings-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to generate a PDF with tagged Roman‑numeral headings using Aspose.Pdf and then validates that the headings follow a correct sequential order.

sanitize-pdf-add-heading.title: Sanitize PDF and Add Navigable Headings
sanitize-pdf-add-heading.description: Shows how to clean a PDF by removing annotations, JavaScript, and embedded files, then enable auto‑tagging and create heading elements for each page to produce a navigable PDF.

generate-crash-report-to-network-share.title: Write Aspose PDF Crash Report to Network Share
generate-crash-report-to-network-share.description: Demonstrates configuring CrashReportOptions to use a UNC network share (with fallback to a local folder) and generating a crash report when a PDF operation fails.

log-pdf-sanitization-start-end-times.title: Sanitize PDF and Record Audit Log
log-pdf-sanitization-start-end-times.description: Shows how to remove annotations, embedded files, and metadata from a PDF using Aspose.Pdf while logging the operation start, end, and duration for auditing.

add-page-with-text-to-pdf.title: Add a New Page with Text to a PDF (No Progress Event)
add-page-with-text-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates loading an existing PDF, adding a new page containing a text fragment, and saving the document, while noting that Aspose.Pdf.Document does not expose a Progress event.

magazine-pdf-creator.title: Create Magazine‑Style PDF with Text and Advertisement
magazine-pdf-creator.description: Shows how to generate a PDF with article text, custom margins, and an optional advertisement image using Aspose.Pdf.

pdf-sanitizer-service.title: PDF Sanitizer Service for Removing Metadata and Annotations
pdf-sanitizer-service.description: Demonstrates a Windows‑service‑style component that watches a folder, loads incoming PDFs with Aspose.Pdf, strips metadata, annotations, form fields and JavaScript, then archives the cleaned file.
